title: Default-cell matched D4 flux-policy comparison
question: On one fixed paper-normalized D4 default cell, how do unit-weight MWPM, the published herald-weight MWPM, and posterior-LLR MWPM driven by the R6D local D4 factor graph differ at flux recovery?
matched_design: Every nonterminal trajectory uses the same physical edge error, flux syndrome, and initial D4 fusion-charge observation for all three first-stage policies. Physical truth is used only after decoding to score Boolean-union winding.
primary_estimands: decoder-contingent first-stage Boolean-union logical-failure probability conditional on a nonterminal physical record
paired flux-stage improvement and regression counts for O2 versus O0 and R6D-BP versus O0
R6D-BP availability and convergence at the Lab 002 default damping/iteration settings
method_boundary: The third policy uses the D4 R6D likelihood graph, not the Lab 002 phenomenological binary-herald likelihood. It tests the Lab 002 posterior-LLR matching principle on D4. A nonconverged but finite 40-iteration BP iterate is decoded exactly as the Lab 002 default policy would; convergence is reported rather than silently repaired. The unscreened local graph is not an exact D4 posterior or a scalable-BP validation.
excluded: claiming Lab 002 likelihood is a D4 likelihood
using physical truth in any policy input

execution.validation: All 11 selected D4 matching/local-BP/R5a runner tests pass; every recorded policy correction is syndrome-faithful through the shared recovery scorer.
